name: Trovavio: SEO & AI Visibility
author: trovavio

sections.description:
Trovavio is an SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) assistant for
small businesses and professionals who are not SEO specialists. It writes
plainly, without jargon, and tells you what to fix first.

Available in English, Italian, Spanish and French. The plugin follows the
language of your WordPress, so there is nothing to set.

Works right away, with no account

These fields live in your own WordPress, so nothing needs to be connected:

  • SEO title, meta description and focus keyword on every page and post.
  • ALT texts for your images, from the media library.
  • Custom canonical URL, noindex and nofollow toggles, editable slug.
  • Google preview and social preview while you write.
  • A live check of each page as you type, with the length of every field.
  • Works WITH your SEO plugin, or on its own lightweight output if you do
    not use one.

With a free Trovavio account

The score is the one thing WordPress cannot know on its own: it is how your
site looks to someone searching for you from the outside. Trovavio reads the
page from its own servers, the way Google and ChatGPT do.

  • SEO + GEO score of your home page, with the points to fix first.
  • Up to 5 analyses a day, on 1 site.

From the Solo plan up

  • AI writes titles, descriptions, keywords and ALT texts for you, and you
    approve them.
  • Structured data for AI engines (GEO): FAQ schema, breadcrumb and
    published/updated dates.
  • llms.txt generation, to tell AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini,
    Claude) what your site is about.
  • Fixes approved in the dashboard are applied to your site automatically.
  • 10 pages per analysis with Solo, more with Pro and Agency.

Supported SEO plugins: Yoast SEO, RankMath, SEOPress, SiteSEO,
All in One SEO, SmartCrawl, Premium SEO Pack, The SEO Framework,
Slim SEO, Squirrly SEO.

A free Trovavio account is available at trovavio.com.

External Services

This plugin can connect your WordPress site to Trovavio, a third-party cloud
service (https://trovavio.com), to provide SEO and GEO (Generative Engine
Optimization) analysis and to apply optimization fixes.

The connection is optional. Without a connection key the plugin sends nothing
at all: every request is stopped before it leaves your site, and the fields
listed above under “Works right away” keep working on your own WordPress data.
A connection is needed only for the site score, the AI suggestions and the
automatic application of approved fixes.

What data is sent to Trovavio (https://trovavio.com/api/plugin):

  • Your site domain and the connection account name.
  • For each published page/post: URL, title, meta title, meta description,
    focus keyword(s), the active SEO plugin name, and a short content snippet
    (used as context for AI suggestions).
  • Image URLs, when you request AI-generated ALT text for an image.

When data is sent:

  • When you connect the site (you paste your connection key in the setup wizard).
  • When you click “Sincronizza” (manual synchronization of your pages).
  • Every 10 minutes via WP-Cron, to download approved fixes and apply them.
  • On demand, when you generate an AI suggestion (title, description, keyword,
    schema, llms.txt or ALT text) from the Trovavio dashboard or the page editor.

No data is sent to any other third party. All requests use HTTPS.

By connecting the plugin you agree to Trovavio’s Terms of Service and Privacy
Policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://trovavio.com/termini
  • Privacy Policy: https://trovavio.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/trovavio/
  2. Activate through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Follow the setup wizard that appears automatically
  4. Paste your connection key from trovavio.com/dashboard
sections.faq:
Do I need a Trovavio account?

Yes. The plugin connects WordPress to your Trovavio account and requires a free
account at trovavio.com. You can create one directly from the plugin setup
wizard (“Sono nuovo”), or paste an existing connection key (“Ho già un account”).

Is it free?

The plugin and a Free account are free. The WordPress one-click apply feature
and the AI generation require a paid plan (Solo or higher). The setup wizard
shows the plans.

What data does the plugin send to Trovavio?

Your page URLs, titles, meta titles/descriptions, focus keywords and a short
content snippet, plus the site domain and account name. See the “External
Services” section above for the full list and links to the Privacy Policy and
Terms of Service.

Does it modify my content or my theme?

No. The plugin writes only SEO meta values (title, meta description, focus
keyword, schema, llms.txt) through the SEO plugin you already use (Yoast,
RankMath, SEOPress and others) or through its own lightweight output. It never
edits your post content or your theme files.

Will it work without WP-Cron?

Yes. If WP-Cron is not firing on your host, approved fixes are still applied
when you open the Trovavio panel in wp-admin. You can also click “Sincronizza”
at any time.

How do I disconnect?

Deactivate the plugin, or remove the connection key from the Trovavio settings
page. No data is sent after disconnection.
sections.changelog:
1.41.3

  • Fixed a problem that could remove the other keywords of a page. If a page had more than one keyword, applying an AI suggestion, filling in fields in bulk, or restoring an older change could leave only one. Your keywords are kept now, and only the main one is replaced.
  • Short keywords such as “AI” or “3D” are recognised again. They were treated as noise, so the plugin said they were missing from the title, the description and the address even when they were there.

1.41.2

  • The social preview now shows the title people will actually see when they share your page. It used to show the post title instead of your SEO title.
  • Structured data and FAQ written directly in your page are now recognised. Before, the plugin only looked at its own fields, so if you had already added them by hand it told you they were missing.

1.41.1

  • Fixed a check that could tell you your keyword was missing from the title, the description and the page address when it was actually there. It used to look for the exact phrase: “reflexology Villasanta” was not recognised in “Reflexology in Villasanta”, because of the word in between.
  • The check now looks at the words of your keyword, and it considers every keyword you have set for the page, not only the first one.

1.41.0

  • Network errors from the background sync no longer show up in your Changes history, or in the PDF report you hand to your client: they were never changes to your site.
  • Changing the keyword from the page detail, or undoing a change from the history, now updates the box in the editor too. Before, the editor kept showing the old keywords and it looked like nothing had been saved.
  • Multiple keywords are shown as a readable list in the history and in the report, instead of the raw [“a”,”b”] text.
  • After a bulk generation the field no longer says “in the queue, it will be applied within 10 minutes”: the value is already on your site, and now the card says so.
  • Two labels in the page detail were always in Italian, whatever language you use. They are translated now.
  • Short pages such as contact, privacy or thank-you pages are no longer marked down for having little text, matching how the report on trovavio.com already treated them.
  • Better readability of the “description missing” warning in the Google preview when WordPress is in dark mode.

1.40.1

  • The page checks now use the same thresholds as the audit on trovavio.com, so the score you read in the editor and the score you read in your report say the same thing about the same page.
  • A page with one or two images missing their alt text is no longer marked as complete: the check tells you how many are missing, and only lowers the score when a large share of them is uncovered.
  • A page now needs at least three links to your other pages, and at least 300 words, to pass those two checks.

1.40.0

  • The SEO score now also looks at the body of the page, not just the title and the description. Six new checks, all done on your own site with no AI: images without alt text, links to your other pages, subheadings, a duplicate main heading inside the text, how much text there is, and whether your keyword appears in the opening lines.
  • Each new check moves the score by a few points at most, so a well kept page stays high and an empty one drops where it belongs.
  • The new checks work in both editors, the block one and the classic one.

1.39.2

  • Fixed a problem that stopped some plugin screens from opening on hosting without the mbstring PHP extension. The pages list, the page detail and the changes report now load on every server.

1.39.1

  • The SEO box in the post editor now works right after installation, with no account: SEO title, description, keyword, canonical URL, the noindex and nofollow switches and the page address are all there from the first minute. Before, that box only said “Connect Trovavio” and showed nothing else, so the canonical URL and the robots switches could not be reached anywhere in the plugin.
  • The suggestions written by the AI still need a Solo, Pro or Agency plan, and the box now says so in one line instead of hiding everything.

1.39.0

  • The plugin now also speaks English, Spanish and French, and picks the language on its own from the one your WordPress uses. If your WordPress is in Italian nothing changes: you keep reading everything in Italian, sentence by sentence as before.
  • Fixed: a suggestion showed stray symbols around the name of a button, and one message was missing an accent.
  • Some button and field labels now use the same words as the rest of the plugin, instead of alternating between two languages.

1.38.6

  • Fixed: the Restore button now works on changes to image alternative text too. It did nothing before, even though it was offered in the History.
  • Fixed: with The SEO Framework or Slim SEO active, the keyword was suggested over and over even after it had been applied. It is now marked as done.

1.38.5

  • Fixed: the SEO and GEO score now updates while you write the text of the page, not only when you edit the Trovavio fields. Before, it stood still exactly when you needed to see it move.
  • Fixed: the AI-generated keyword now starts from the text in front of you, even if you have not saved it yet. Before, on a draft in progress, it could suggest a keyword that had nothing to do with the article.
  • Fixed: if two pieces of content share the same short address, Trovavio no longer guesses which one to write on. Before, it could apply the suggestion to the wrong page.
  • Fixed: undoing a change to schema, FAQ or llms.txt now confirms the restore only when it really worked. Before, it could confirm even when the content stayed as it was.
  • Fixed: the “Apply now” button finds pending suggestions even if the site has moved from http to https in the meantime, or a slash in the address has changed.

1.38.4

  • New: “Make it clearer”. Trovavio reads the text of the page and offers smoother versions of the sentences that are hard to follow, ready to copy. It works only from what you wrote: it does not add facts, cities or numbers that are not there.
  • Improved: when you ask to improve the title or the description and they are already fine, Trovavio tells you so instead of proposing a pointless change, and it uses no credits.

1.38.3

  • Fixed: the AI now really reads the content of the page even while it is still a draft. Before, on an unpublished post, titles and descriptions came out generic and the keywords had nothing to do with the article (they were taken from the general topic of the site).
  • Improved: almost three times as much of the page text reaches the AI, so the suggestions match what you wrote more closely.
  • Fixed: typing a value by hand and pressing Save now turns the field label to “OK” instead of leaving it on “Missing”.
  • Fixed: the social preview recognises the featured image as soon as you set it, with no need to reload the page.

1.38.2

  • Fixed: choosing “Plain” or “Technical” now really changes the AI explanation when you use “Generate with AI” on an empty field too. Before, the help text changed but the explanation was not shown, so the setting looked useless.

1.38.1

  • The home page, the categories and the archive pages now introduce themselves to search engines with a proper title and description too (when Trovavio handles the SEO of the site).
  • A cleaner SEO box in the editor: the Google preview shows only the snippet, with a single length indicator next to each field.
  • New readability warning in the SEO box: it points out sentences that are too long, to make your text easier to read.
  • AI requests now have an hourly limit per user, so on sites with several authors the credits are not used up by mistake.

1.38.0

  • Your posts now tell Google and the AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity) who wrote them and when: more authority, and a better chance of being quoted.
  • The home page now introduces itself to search engines with your business details (name, logo, official site), so you are recognised more easily.
  • Fuller social previews when you share a page (site name, language, author, image with a description).
  • Changing the address (slug) of a page? Trovavio automatically creates a 301 redirect from the old one to the new one, so existing links keep working and you do not lose rankings.
  • The PDF report now shows your real SEO and GEO score, not just how complete the fields are.
  • You can see the AI credits you have left right in the SEO box of the editor, where you use them.
  • The plugin screens always open quickly, even on slow hosting.
  • If you remove the plugin, all of its data (including the connection key) is now deleted from the site.
  • General stability improvements.

1.37.1

  • Cleaner Google preview in the SEO box: the coloured background behind the preview is gone, so the box no longer looks stuck onto a yellowish panel.

1.37.0

  • The SEO box in the editor now shows two separate scores: one for Google (SEO) and one for visibility on AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Gemini (GEO).
  • New traffic-light analysis of the page: a clear list of what to improve in order to rank better, updated while you write.
  • The technical settings (address, slug, visibility in search engines) are now grouped in a collapsible “Advanced settings” section, so the box is cleaner and simpler to use.
  • Fixed social preview: the sharing image now appears at the right proportions, no longer blown up.
  • The “Improve with AI” buttons are more discreet, so they do not distract from the content.

1.36.10

  • The “Restore” button now makes the restored value visible online right away, even on sites with caching enabled.
  • Fixed some confirmation and error messages that appeared with no colour or emphasis on certain screens.
  • Generating the llms.txt file now updates the AI credit counter immediately.
  • The “Title not set” placeholder in the Google preview is now readable with a dark theme too.
  • In the change history you can now filter by “Image ALT” and “llms.txt” as well.
  • Small text corrections.

1.36.9

  • New: in the SEO box of every page you can choose how the AI explains its advice. With “Plain” it speaks without technical jargon, as you would to a friend; with “Technical” it uses the standard SEO terms (title tag, meta description and so on). Your choice is remembered by your browser and applies to both “Generate with AI” and “Improve with AI”.

1.36.8

  • Fixed a problem where the buttons (Save, Apply, Generate) turned pale and hard to read when you moved the mouse over them: they now stay clearly visible.
  • Better readability of buttons and labels in dark mode (the dark theme of your system): no more pale boxes out of place, no more low-contrast text.
  • The red “Disconnect” button stays recognisable under the mouse pointer too.
  • The AI credit counter now updates immediately when you generate alternative text for images too, so the number you see is always right.
  • The WordPress page opens faster: background checks no longer slow down the panel on hosting with a slow connection.
  • More careful interface text: accents and apostrophes are now correct on every screen of the plugin.

1.36.7

  • New: on sites without another SEO plugin, Trovavio automatically adds two pieces of structured data that AI engines find useful: the navigation path (breadcrumb) and the publication and update date of the page. They help ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google understand where the page sits and how up to date it is, raising the GEO score with nothing for you to do. If you already use Yoast or RankMath nothing changes, since they add them.

1.36.6

  • Better readability in dark mode (the dark theme of your system): the “Title not set” notice in the Google preview, the next-step box in the Overview and the “AI proposal” boxes in the page list are no longer pale or hard to read.
  • Character counters and length bars are now readable with a dark theme too.
  • Small security and clean-up improvements (certificate check on internal requests, page data read more safely).

1.36.5

  • Fixed a problem where some buttons (for example “Save” in the editor) turned white and unreadable under the mouse pointer.
  • The counter of images without alternative text now updates right after you generate the texts, with no need to reload the page.
  • When you add a keyword suggested by the AI, the ones already there stay: you now build a list of keywords instead of replacing them.
  • The “What do you do or sell?” field used to generate the llms.txt file now widens and shows long text in full.

1.36.4

  • When you apply many fixes at once (“Apply all”) on sites with caching enabled (LiteSpeed, for example), the long list of “clear the cache” notices that filled the screen is gone: the cache is now cleared once per page.
  • More breathing room in the single page detail view: more space between boxes and edges, so it is easier to read.

1.36.3

  • PHP requirement lowered to 7.2 (from 7.4) for even wider hosting compatibility: the plugin uses no function from the more recent PHP versions.
  • Maintenance and stability improvements.

1.36.2

  • The “Exclude from search engines” and “Do not follow links” switches now work with ANY SEO plugin (including SEOPress, All in One SEO, The SEO Framework and similar), not only with Yoast and RankMath: when you turn them on, the page really is excluded from Google. With those other plugins the canonical URL still has to be set from their own panel, and a note in the box reminds you.

1.36.1

  • The plugin now works with PHP 7.4 as well: if your hosting is not on PHP 8 yet, you can finally install and update Trovavio (the update used to be blocked).
  • If you use another SEO plugin (SEOPress or All in One SEO, for example), the “Exclude from search engines” and “Do not follow links” switches and the canonical URL field no longer appear as if they had been saved: in their place there is a note inviting you to manage them from your SEO plugin, so you do not believe a page is excluded when it is still on Google. With Yoast, RankMath or no other SEO plugin, everything stays as before.
  • Better security on image alternative text: generating or saving it now requires edit permission on that individual image.

1.36.0

  • The “Exclude from search engines” and “Do not follow links” switches now really work when Yoast or RankMath are active too: before, the page stayed visible on Google even with the switch turned on.
  • The status label next to the title of the Trovavio SEO box no longer appears on drafts that have just been created (a post that is still empty).
  • Fixed a case where a keyword starting with a square bracket was deleted on save instead of being saved.
  • Fixed a case where, with the computer in dark mode, the status label in the box title was hard to read.
  • Fixed a case where a canonical URL written without https blocked the page from being saved, with no message at all.
  • The welcome screen after activation now opens more reliably, even with other WordPress tabs open.
  • A sturdier activation flow: a clear message when the session expires, keyboard submit to confirm, and the password requirement shown correctly.

1.35.2

  • The AI credit counter now updates immediately when you generate a schema, the FAQ or the llms.txt file too, with no need to reload the page
  • If you have run out of credits, the button tells you so with a clear message instead of trying anyway

1.35.1

  • You now always know what happens before you hide a page from Google: under every option there is a clear explanation, and a prominent warning when you exclude a page from search results
  • Clearer SEO box: a single icon to open and close the panel, no more duplicate controls to confuse you
  • The “Improve with AI” button now looks like the other buttons in the panel

1.35.0

  • New: a field to change the slug of the page directly from the SEO box
  • New: a field to set a custom canonical URL
  • New: an option to exclude a page from search engines (noindex/nofollow)
  • New: a visual indicator of the SEO status of the page (Good / To improve / Critical)
  • Improved: you can now enter more than one keyword per page
  • Fixed: the featured image preview was no longer distorted
  • Fixed: sharing links on social networks and WhatsApp now shows the featured image of the page correctly, instead of the site logo
  • Fixed: uneven spacing in the Google/Social preview card

1.34.21

  • Single page fix: the “Generate/Improve with AI” and “Save” buttons did nothing (they spun without changing anything). The buttons and the field card had the same data-field attribute and the code walked up to the button instead of the card: generation now shows the proposal and saving writes the right value.

1.34.20

  • Keyword: “Generate with AI” in the page list now offers several keywords to choose from (multiple selection with pills, as in the other SEO plugins), no longer a single string. The first one is the main one. With RankMath they are all saved; with Yoast and the others the main one is native and the rest stay in the Trovavio field.
  • Fixed “Page not synchronised”: AI generation no longer failed to find pages that were in fact synchronised, when the permalink differed in harmless details (trailing slash, http/https, www). The match is now tolerant.

1.34.19

  • Fixed the “Generate with AI” button in the meta box: on hover the background turned pale with white text (invisible). It now stays light blue on hover.

1.34.18

  • Synchronisation with the dashboard: SEO changes applied directly from the plugin (page editor, meta box, bulk generation) are now reported to Trovavio, so they appear right away in the history and in the dashboard status. Before, only fixes downloaded from the queue were tracked.

1.34.17

  • GEO: applied fixes (JSON-LD schema, FAQ, meta) now clear the page cache (LiteSpeed, WP Rocket, W3TC, WP Super Cache) so they are immediately visible to Google, to the AI engines and to the Trovavio analysis. Before, on sites with caching, a schema that had just been applied could stay invisible until the cache expired.
  • GEO: serving /llms.txt made sturdier (the request is intercepted earlier) for the hosts where the rewrite rule alone caused a 301 redirect.

1.34.16

  • WordPress.org review: inline CSS and JS removed. The admin bar badge style, the notice dismiss script and the styles and scripts of the Report page are now properly enqueued files. The WP-Cron URL is generated with add_query_arg/site_url. Contributor updated. No change in behaviour for the user.

1.34.15

  • Plugin Check: the last 2 errors cleared (the “translators:” comment is now placed directly above the _n() calls in the page detail). Zero errors.

1.34.14

  • WordPress.org Plugin Check compliance: all errors resolved (translator comments on translatable strings with placeholders; escaped output of the SVG icons) and the main warnings too (explicit nonce checks in the AJAX handlers, input sanitisation, correct variable scope in the admin templates). No change in behaviour for the user.

1.34.13

  • WordPress.org compliance: “Plugin URI” and “Author URI” are now different (Plugin Check reported them as identical). Plugin URI points to https://trovavio.com/wordpress, Author URI to https://trovavio.com.
  • Added the LICENSE file (the full GPLv2 text) in the plugin folder.

1.34.12

  • Bulk “Everything” generation: it now REALLY generates every missing field, SEO and GEO (Schema and FAQ). Before, “Everything” covered only title, description and keyword, so on pages with complete SEO it said “no field to generate” even when the GEO was missing.
  • Page list: pages not yet included in an analysis show “Not analysed yet” instead of staying empty, so it is clear why only some of them have a score (the analysis examines the main pages up to the limit of your plan, not all of them).

1.34.11

  • “Connection status and diagnostics” now has an arrow showing that it opens: before it looked like an empty heading (it was a closed panel with no visible arrow).
  • GEO: after applying Schema or FAQ from the page detail, the status updates right away (badge and buttons). Before it stayed on “missing” until you reloaded.
  • Page list: a new “GEO to complete” filter showing the pages that are missing Schema or FAQ (before, “To improve” counted only title, description and keyword).
  • After a bulk generation, a reminder to press “Update analysis” and recalculate the score (the applied fixes change the site, but the score only updates after a new analysis).

1.34.10

  • Logo in the WordPress admin bar: before, the 16px navy square disappeared against the dark background of the bar. It now uses the mark itself (with no square) in a light colour with a terracotta accent, larger and vertically centred.

1.34.9

  • The remaining points of the UI/UX review completed: the weak-point sentence now has a button that takes you straight there; the “No page” and “No change in the queue” empty states have a button (“Synchronise now”, “Generate the first improvements”).
  • Clearer pending-fix banner (“N improvements approved and ready”) with a link to approve more on the dashboard.
  • A spinner on “Apply now” too, while it is applying.
  • Consistency: the page list shows “Last analysis” from the same source as the Overview.
  • Accessibility: touch targets raised to 44px; secondary text with higher contrast.

1.34.8

  • A clearer Overview: a new “How it works” strip (Trovavio analyses, you approve, the plugin applies) with the current step highlighted.
  • Under the scores there is now a sentence naming the weak point (SEO or GEO) and what to do first, with a direct link.
  • When there is no analysis yet, a clear invitation to run the first one with a click.
  • AI credits used up: the message now has a clickable “Buy credits” button.
  • Accessibility: a visible focus outline on every button and larger targets on touch devices.
  • Mobile: statistics on two columns, and a status bar that wraps instead of overflowing.

1.34.7

  • “Update analysis” now REALLY runs a new analysis of the site (before it only reloaded the last saved score): the button shows “Analysis in progress…”, waits for the new audit and then updates the score.
  • Bulk generation and ALT: a safety timeout on the AI requests (no more endless waiting if a call gets stuck).
  • Clarity: tooltips on “Synchronise now” and on the “GEO (AI)” row explaining what they do. The required-field asterisk is now consistent in dark mode.

1.34.6

  • llms.txt: after generating, the badge turns to “Configured” (it stayed on “Missing” before) and the preview of long text no longer spills out of the card.

1.34.5

  • Overview: every card now has the same background. Before, some of them (History, Quick actions) had a slightly creamy background and looked inconsistent next to the others.

1.34.4

  • A wider, better balanced welcome page: the four plans have more room and are no longer squeezed on wide screens.
  • WordPress.org compliance: added the “External Services” section (a declaration of the data sent to trovavio.com), a FAQ section, License URI in the header, “Tested up to” updated. A dedicated message when the AI credits are used up.

1.34.3

  • The “Trovavio SEO” meta box in the page and post editor now always stays light: before, with the operating system in dark mode, fields and previews turned dark inside the white WordPress editor and the labels were unreadable.

1.34.2

  • The “GEO and AI visibility (llms.txt)” module now follows dark mode: no more white panel, fields and text use the colours of the theme.

1.34.1

  • Overview in dark mode sorted out: the score and change labels (78, = stable…) are no longer white boxes but follow the theme; the SEO and GEO icons are visible on a dark background too; the score circle has the right track colour. The small analyses chart now makes the differences between scores visible (61 and 70 used to look the same), with the numbers attached to the bars. Recent history: the double border at the bottom of the rows is gone and the inner spacing is back.

1.34.0

  • Full brand review: the printable report now uses the official Trovavio colours (the greens, oranges and reds of the palette, with consistent text and borders; on the navy cover scores, the light variants that stay readable). The red status backgrounds (low score, negative change) use the theme colour, so they stay correct in dark mode too. Finishing touches: a maximum height on the notes field of the page detail, a visible scrollbar in dark mode, proposal buttons that wrap on mobile, compact image cards on narrow screens.

1.33.1

  • Small visual fixes in the Overview: in the “Recent history” card the change-type label (FAQ schema, Focus keyword…) now fits the text instead of stretching across the whole column; the “See the site pages” button is no longer underlined.

1.33.0

  • New welcome page (onboarding): it explains what Trovavio does, shows the plans and lets you start in two ways. “I am new”: you create the Trovavio account straight from the plugin (name, email, password) and the site is connected automatically. “I already have an account”: you paste the API key and connect the site right away. The design matches the Trovavio brand (the colours and fonts of the plugin), with no external fonts. Registration goes through a dedicated endpoint with anti-abuse protection.

1.32.1

  • Overview: the Score card now sits in two columns (Score on the left, History and Actions on the right) instead of taking the full width, so the SEO/GEO rows and the small chart are no longer stretched with too much empty space. History bars grouped and at a fixed width.

short_description: Write titles, descriptions, keywords and ALT texts on every page. No account needed. Connect Trovavio for the SEO + GEO score of your site.
description:
Trovavio is an SEO and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) assistant for
small businesses and professionals who are not SEO specialists. It writes
plainly, without jargon, and tells you what to fix first.

Available in English, Italian, Spanish and French. The plugin follows the
language of your WordPress, so there is nothing to set.

Works right away, with no account

These fields live in your own WordPress, so nothing needs to be connected:

  • SEO title, meta description and focus keyword on every page and post.
  • ALT texts for your images, from the media library.
  • Custom canonical URL, noindex and nofollow toggles, editable slug.
  • Google preview and social preview while you write.
  • A live check of each page as you type, with the length of every field.
  • Works WITH your SEO plugin, or on its own lightweight output if you do
    not use one.

With a free Trovavio account

The score is the one thing WordPress cannot know on its own: it is how your
site looks to someone searching for you from the outside. Trovavio reads the
page from its own servers, the way Google and ChatGPT do.

  • SEO + GEO score of your home page, with the points to fix first.
  • Up to 5 analyses a day, on 1 site.

From the Solo plan up

  • AI writes titles, descriptions, keywords and ALT texts for you, and you
    approve them.
  • Structured data for AI engines (GEO): FAQ schema, breadcrumb and
    published/updated dates.
  • llms.txt generation, to tell AI crawlers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini,
    Claude) what your site is about.
  • Fixes approved in the dashboard are applied to your site automatically.
  • 10 pages per analysis with Solo, more with Pro and Agency.

Supported SEO plugins: Yoast SEO, RankMath, SEOPress, SiteSEO,
All in One SEO, SmartCrawl, Premium SEO Pack, The SEO Framework,
Slim SEO, Squirrly SEO.

A free Trovavio account is available at trovavio.com.

External Services

This plugin can connect your WordPress site to Trovavio, a third-party cloud
service (https://trovavio.com), to provide SEO and GEO (Generative Engine
Optimization) analysis and to apply optimization fixes.

The connection is optional. Without a connection key the plugin sends nothing
at all: every request is stopped before it leaves your site, and the fields
listed above under “Works right away” keep working on your own WordPress data.
A connection is needed only for the site score, the AI suggestions and the
automatic application of approved fixes.

What data is sent to Trovavio (https://trovavio.com/api/plugin):

  • Your site domain and the connection account name.
  • For each published page/post: URL, title, meta title, meta description,
    focus keyword(s), the active SEO plugin name, and a short content snippet
    (used as context for AI suggestions).
  • Image URLs, when you request AI-generated ALT text for an image.

When data is sent:

  • When you connect the site (you paste your connection key in the setup wizard).
  • When you click “Sincronizza” (manual synchronization of your pages).
  • Every 10 minutes via WP-Cron, to download approved fixes and apply them.
  • On demand, when you generate an AI suggestion (title, description, keyword,
    schema, llms.txt or ALT text) from the Trovavio dashboard or the page editor.

No data is sent to any other third party. All requests use HTTPS.

By connecting the plugin you agree to Trovavio’s Terms of Service and Privacy
Policy:

  • Terms of Service: https://trovavio.com/termini
  • Privacy Policy: https://trovavio.com/privacy
